events.verdict: LaVine (SAC) places his off-arm against Jones Jr. (LAC) and releases from contact as he slows his momentum.
Murray (SAC) jumps into and initiates contact with Leonard's (LAC) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Jones Jr. (LAC) immediately slides his hand off Valanciunas' (SAC) body and the contact is marginal during the pick.
Valanciunas (SAC) delivers illegal leg-to-leg contact to Harden (LAC) during the screen.
LaVine's (SAC) hand brushes Zubac's (LAC) arm and the contact is marginal during the dunk.

Replay review of the foul called on Jones Jr. (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Jones Jr. makes incidental contact with DeRozan's (SAC) hand after he has released his shot, and some marginal arm contact thereafter. The ball is loose at the point of interruption and therefore play resumes with a jump ball at center circle.
Coffey (LAC) obtains a legal guarding position in front of DeRozan (SAC) during his jump shot attempt. Coffey maintains that position as DeRozan drifts into him and the contact is incidental.
Valanciunas (SAC) jumps to contest Harden's (LAC) driving shot attempt and the ensuing contact after his release is marginal.
Leonard (LAC) briefly has an arm around DeRozan (SAC) during the throw-in and immediately removes it.
Dunn (LAC) and LaVine (SAC) briefly engage and separate on the perimeter.
Harden (LAC) legally contests LaVine's (SAC) jump shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) throws the ball off Coffey's (LAC) body and Coffey is the last player to touch the ball before it rolls out of bounds.
Jones Jr. (LAC) reaches in and makes clean contact with the ball while defending DeRozan (SAC).
Valanciunas (SAC) establishes himself in a screening position in Jones Jr.'s (LAC) path and the ensuing contact between the two players is marginal.

Zubac (LAC) legally contests DeRozan's (SAC) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released. Additionally, Zubac allows DeRozan to land following the release of his jump shot attempt.

Coffey (LAC) initiates contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt. The illegal contact occurs after DeRozan's gather on a drive that originates outside of the LDB and ends inside it, and therefore a shooting foul is correctly called.
Replay review of the out of bounds called on Harden (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Harden is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Leonard (LAC) makes contact with the ball to dislodge it from Valanciunas's (SAC) possession and any contact with his arm is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the ball never makes contact with the rim and therefore the shot clock was erroneously reset at the 00:46.6 mark. Play continued and DeRozan (SAC) releases his shot attempt prior to when the shot clock would have hypothetically expired and the basket is scored.
LaRavia (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Harden (LAC) during his drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Dunn (LAC) initiates contact with DeRozan's (SAC) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Ellis (SAC) intentionally kicks the ball.
Murray (SAC) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Leonard (LAC) as he defends in the post.
Valanciunas (SAC) and Murray (SAC) legally contest Leonard's (LAC) last-second shot attempt.
